Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - CC/1024/2024

Dear Mr. Rao,

Thank you for meeting us on 22 January 2025 about your dispute with Meera Khan. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Nagpur.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹12,90,000.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Nagpur
